tools.name: civitai_lora_inventory
tools.description: Inventory of the LoRAs installed in the local Stable Diffusion WebUI. Each item has: name (file), prompt_tag (ready-to-use <lora:name:1>), subfolder, size, civitai info when known (model_name, version_name, base_model, trained_words = trigger words, nsfw, model_url) and training metadata read from the file itself (training.base_model_version, training.top_tags) so LoRAs that are not on civitai still show what they were trained on. Optional q filters by file name, model name, trigger word or training tag. Use it for 'what LoRAs do I have', 'which LoRA fits X', or to pick a LoRA and its trigger words for a prompt. Results are paged: use q to narrow, or offset to see more.

q.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter (file name, model name, trigger word or training tag)

limit.description: Max items to return (default 15; keep it small, entries are ~600 chars each)

tools.result_note: In an image prompt use prompt_tag (adjust the weight, e.g. :0.8) plus the civitai.trained_words; when there are none, use a few training.top_tags instead. Mention base_model / training.base_model_version so the user picks a LoRA that matches the checkpoint. 'total' is the number of LoRAs matching; if it exceeds 'count', say so and offer to narrow with q. 'examples' is the number of example images saved locally; civitai_model_examples gives the example prompts of one LoRA.

tools.name: civitai_list_local_models
tools.description: List models installed in the local Stable Diffusion WebUI of one type (lora, ckp = checkpoint, ti = textual-inversion embedding, hyper = hypernetwork), with civitai info when known: model name, base model and trained_words (the trigger words). Optional q filters by file name, model name or trigger word. For LoRAs prefer civitai_lora_inventory (richer); use this for checkpoints, embeddings and hypernetworks, or for a compact LoRA list.

type.description: Model type: lora | ckp (checkpoint) | ti (embedding) | hyper (hypernetwork)

q.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on file name, model name or trigger word

no_info_only.description: Only models that have no civitai info file yet

tools.result_note: A LoRA is used in a prompt as <lora:FILE_NAME_WITHOUT_EXTENSION:0.8>, and its civitai.trained_words are the trigger words to add to the prompt.

tools.name: civitai_local_model_info
tools.description: Civitai details stored for ONE installed model: model/version ids, model name, base model, trigger words, whether a preview exists, how many example images are saved locally (examples) and whether the card has description info (has_card_info). Give the file name (e.g. foo.safetensors) or the path relative to the model folder. For the example prompts / images themselves use civitai_model_examples.

name.description: File name or relative path inside the model folder

tools.name: civitai_model_examples
tools.description: The civitai EXAMPLE images of ONE installed model, each with its generation parameters: prompt, negative_prompt, steps, sampler, cfg_scale, seed, size, model (checkpoint used), nsfw flag, the civitai image url, and local_file / local_url when the image was saved locally with civitai_download_examples. Also returns trained_words, base_model, downloaded/total counts, has_preview and has_card_info. Use it when the user asks for example prompts, sample images, 'how do I use this LoRA', 'show me what it looks like', or wants a proven prompt to start from.

type.description: Model type: lora | ckp (checkpoint) | ti (embedding) | hyper (hypernetwork)

name.description: File name (e.g. foo.safetensors) or path relative to the model folder

tools.result_note: Present 1-3 of the examples that have a prompt: the prompt (shortened if very long), negative prompt, steps / sampler / cfg / seed and checkpoint, plus the LoRA's prompt_tag and trigger words. The images are already shown to the user as a gallery; never write image markdown or URLs. If images are attached for you, you may describe what they show. Offer to generate with a prompt, to save the images locally (civitai_download_examples), or to write the prompts onto the card (civitai_write_card_info).

tools.name: civitai_lookup_model
tools.description: Look up a model on civitai by its model id or model page URL (https://civitai.com/models/12345/...). Returns name, type, nsfw flag, creator, description, the target model folder with its existing subfolders, and every version (id, name, base model, trigger words, files). Versions are listed newest first. Use it before downloading, or when the user pastes a civitai link.

url_or_id.description: civitai model id or model page URL

tools.result_note: Summarize for the user: name, type, base model of the newest version, trigger words, file size, and nsfw if true. Ask which version/subfolder to use only if it is unclear.

tools.name: civitai_download_model
tools.description: Download a civitai model version into the WebUI's model folder for its type (LoRA, checkpoint, embedding or hypernetwork), then save its civitai info file and preview image. Defaults to the newest version and the folder root. The call waits up to ~9 minutes; larger checkpoints may still be running afterwards.

url_or_id.description: civitai model id or model page URL

subfolder.description: Subfolder under the model type folder, e.g. '/' (default) or '/characters'

create_subfolder.description: Create the subfolder if it does not exist

dl_all.description: Download every file of the version instead of only the primary one

tools.result_note: If status is 'done': report result.file and result.trained_words, then call refresh_loras (for a LoRA) or refresh_checkpoints (for a checkpoint) so the WebUI sees the new file. If status is 'running': tell the user the download continues in the background and check later with civitai_task_status using the task id. If status is 'error': relay the error (a login/API-key error means the civitai API key must be set in the WebUI Settings → Civitai Helper).

tools.name: civitai_scan_models
tools.description: Scan the local model folders of the given types and fetch the missing civitai info files and preview images (matches files by SHA256 against civitai). Use when the user wants trigger words / previews for models that lack them, or after copying models in manually. Can take minutes for many models.
tools.result_note: If status is 'running', the scan continues in the background; check later with civitai_task_status.

tools.name: civitai_check_new_versions
tools.description: Check which installed models of the given types have a newer version on civitai. Returns, per model, the new version name, description, download URL and preview URL. Can take minutes for many models.
tools.result_note: Present the list to the user (model name → new version). To install one, call civitai_download_model with its model_id and the new_version_id.

tools.name: civitai_fetch_previews
tools.description: Download the missing card preview image (.preview.png) for installed models that have none, using the example images already stored in their civitai info (tries every example image; no civitai API lookup, so it is fast and safe to run on all models). Batch mode: model_types. Single model: type + name. Use when cards show no picture, after civitai_scan_models reported failures, or when the user asks to fix / restore previews.

model_types.description: Batch mode: model types to process (omit when giving type + name)

type.description: Model type: lora | ckp (checkpoint) | ti (embedding) | hyper (hypernetwork)

name.description: Single model mode: file name (e.g. foo.safetensors) or path relative to the model folder

tools.result_note: Report result.downloaded / exists / failed / no_info. Models listed in failed_models have example images that civitai deleted (404): they cannot be fixed automatically; the user can drop any image next to the model file as <model>.preview.png. If status is 'running', check later with civitai_task_status. After success call refresh_loras / refresh_checkpoints so the WebUI shows the new previews.

tools.name: civitai_download_examples
tools.description: Save the civitai example images of installed models next to the model file as <model>.example_NN.<ext> (NN = position in the civitai list, matching the prompts from civitai_model_examples). Batch mode: model_types (+ max_images per model, 0 = all). Single model: type + name. Honors the WebUI's 'Skip NSFW Preview Images' setting. Many models x ~10 images takes a long time and disk space, so for batch mode confirm with the user first and suggest max_images (e.g. 3).

model_types.description: Batch mode: model types to process (omit when giving type + name)

type.description: Model type: lora | ckp (checkpoint) | ti (embedding) | hyper (hypernetwork)

name.description: Single model mode: file name (e.g. foo.safetensors) or path relative to the model folder

max_images.description: Example images to keep per model (0 = all, default 0). Suggest 3-5 for batch runs.

overwrite.description: Re-download images that already exist (default false)

tools.result_note: Report result.downloaded / existed / skipped_nsfw / failed (and models_with_failures = images civitai has deleted). If status is 'running' the download continues in the background; check later with civitai_task_status. The saved files are listed by civitai_model_examples as local_file.

tools.name: civitai_write_card_info
tools.description: Write the trigger words and example prompts into the WebUI's Extra Networks card metadata (<model>.json): 'description' = trigger words + first example prompt / negative / steps / sampler / cfg / seed (shown on the card face), 'notes' = every example prompt in full (shown in the card's edit dialog), and 'sd version' (Forge preset: sd / xl / flux ...) derived from the civitai base model when unknown. By default only EMPTY fields are filled, so hand-written descriptions survive; overwrite=true replaces description / notes. Batch mode: model_types. Single model: type + name. Use when the user wants example prompts visible on the cards / in the WebUI, or asks to 'add descriptions to my LoRAs'.

model_types.description: Batch mode: model types to process (omit when giving type + name)

type.description: Model type: lora | ckp (checkpoint) | ti (embedding) | hyper (hypernetwork)

name.description: Single model mode: file name (e.g. foo.safetensors) or path relative to the model folder

overwrite.description: Replace existing description / notes (default false = fill empty fields only)

set_sd_version.description: Also fill the card's 'sd version' from the civitai base model when unknown (default true)

tools.result_note: Report result.written / unchanged / no_info / bad_json. Tell the user to click Refresh in the WebUI's Extra Networks (LoRA) tab to see the new descriptions; cards show 3 lines and expand on hover, the full example prompts are in the card's edit (pencil) dialog under Notes.

tools.name: civitai_task_status
tools.description: Poll a background Civitai Helper task (download / scan / check-new-version / fetch-previews / download-examples / write-card-info) by its id. Waits up to 60 s for it to finish before returning.

task_id.description: Task id returned by a previous download/scan/check call

tools.name: refresh_loras
tools.description: Make the WebUI re-scan its LoRA folder so a newly downloaded LoRA can be used immediately. Call it after a successful LoRA download.

tools.name: refresh_checkpoints
tools.description: Make the WebUI re-scan its checkpoint folder so a newly downloaded checkpoint appears in the model list. Call it after a successful checkpoint download.
